title: Bariyan Pehne Huey Qafila Salaar Chala, Hy Beemar Chala
body:
Bariyan Pehne Huey Qafla Salaar Chala Hy Beemar Chala.
<<DIVIDER>>
Arahi Hai Dar-o-Deewar Ronay Ki Sada, Hy Beemar Chala.
<<DIVIDER>>
Hy Jalte Hai Zameen Aag Ugalti Hai Zameen
Koyi Saaya Bhi Nehi (x2)
Chalay Par Gaye Paron Mein Aur Badan Tapnay Laga, Hy Beemar Chala.
<<DIVIDER>>
Chain Kia Hathon Pe Gardan Pe Paray Hain Chalay
Koyi Paani Dalay (x2)
Tapti Hai Tauq-o-salat Til Hai Garm Hawa, Hy Beemar Chala.
<<DIVIDER>>
Kantay Chub Jatay Hain Chalay Kabhi Chil Jatay Hain
Hy Dukh Patay Hain (x2)
Paon Behrana Aur Yeh Aziyat Ka Safar Aur Yeh Jafa, Hy Beemar Chala.
<<DIVIDER>>
Aaha Kartay Hain To Duron Saza Patay
Yun Tarap Jatay Hain (x2)
Hy Kis Haal Mein Hain Ibn Shahay Karbobala, Hy Beemar Chala.
<<DIVIDER>>
Cheenkh Uthatay Hain Jab Lahu Se Behta Hai
Har Sitam Sehta Hai (x2)
Dukh Faryad Karay Bhai Na Baba Na Chacha, Hy Beemar Chala.
<<DIVIDER>>
Dekh Kar Bete Ki Halat To Tarap Uthti Hai Maa
Yeh Bhi Hota Hai Guman (x2)
Aa Na Jaye Kahin Beemar Ko Rastay Mein Qaza, Hy Beemar Chala.
<<DIVIDER>>
Sar Khulay Hain Mayein Hain Behnay Hain Sitamgaron
Hy Bazaron Mein (x2)
Sir Jhukaye Rotay Huey Haye Khuddar Chala, Hy Beemar Chala.
<<DIVIDER>>
Hy Kis Haal Mein Sibt-e-payambar Safdar
Khaak Urao Gohar(x2)
Pheet Kar Seena-o -sir Bain Karo Ahl-e-Zza, Hy Beemar Chala.
